Experiment A
Pour 100 cm3 of hot water into the beaker.
Place the thermometer in the water in the beaker.
In the first row of Table 2.1, record the temperature θA of the water at time t = 0 s and
immediately start the stop-watch.

Experiment B
Pour 100 cm3 of hot water into the beaker.
Place the thermometer in the water in the beaker.
Wait until the temperature θB of the water has reached the same value as the temperature θA
at t = 90 s in Experiment A.

immediately start the stop-watch.
